title: Honest measurement ranges
notes: First routes in all bands: P1-2, using allowed endpoint choices to test each promise; add P3 for range-card design. On return, K-1 can make gap extremes (P4-5), compare shared and separate strips (P6), or fill the exact total (P7). Grades 2-3 can find difference ranges and compare repeated pieces (P5-7), then enumerate fixed-total whole-unit pairs (P8). Grades 4-5 can tighten the linked-total range and cancel the very same piece (P8-9) after the dependency comparison in P7. Keep one unchanged A whenever a problem repeats it.
